tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an allowed application or file on the system.

target.description: App name (e.g. 'notepad', 'chrome') or absolute file path.

tools.name: organize_desktop
tools.description: Scan the Desktop for loose files and move them into categorised folders.

preview.description: If true, only return a preview of planned moves without executing.

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a countdown timer or Pomodoro session.

label.description: Optional label for the timer (e.g. 'Take a break').

pomodoro.description: If true, start a full Pomodoro cycle.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Record that the user completed a daily habit.

tools.name: get_habit_streak
tools.description: Return the current streak and history for a habit.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Respond to the user with a plain-text message (no tool action needed).

text.description: The reply to show / speak to the user.
